description: DAY 0 master v6 - locks the official Ecuanutrition isotype as visual reference via images.edit. Same iconic creative direction as v5 (Aquaman gravitas + Spider-Verse blocking + Pixar warmth) but the brand emblem on shoulder clasps and belt medallion is now derived from the real PNG isotype provided by Ecuanutrition, not an AI approximation. Manual dispatch only — does not auto-run on push.
prompt:
ICONIC HERO KEY ART POSTER for ECUAMAN — the official superhero ambassador of ECUANUTRITION (Ecuadorian premium aquaculture brand). This is launch-day visual that must define a new standard in mascot design — the level of THE MANDALORIAN promotional poster, AQUAMAN's cinematic god-ray reveal, SPIDER-VERSE's bold color blocking, and PIXAR's warmth in COCO and LUCA. NOT a generic AI mascot illustration. Premium global launch quality.

MOOD: regal, proud, ceremonial, cinematic gravitas. Calm confident gaze, NOT cartoon smiling, NOT goofy. ECUAMAN is the embodiment of every Ecuadorian shrimp farmer protecting their craft.

COMPOSITION: dramatic low-angle hero shot, vertical 9:16 poster format. Subject perfectly centered, occupies 70 percent of frame height. Three-quarter front view, slight tilt of the head. Trident held diagonally across the body from lower-right hip to upper-left shoulder, making a strong line of action across the silhouette. Left arm extended down and slightly out, palm open and turned forward in a calm welcoming gesture. Cape billowing in a long sweeping S-curve behind the body to the upper-right, mirroring the curved shrimp tail at the bottom — visual rhyme between cape and tail.

CINEMATIC LIGHTING (critical): single warm gold key light from upper-left at 45 degrees creating a brilliant rim along the left silhouette of the body and cape. Cool cyan plasma rim light from the right side (emanating from the trident energy) carving the right silhouette. Center of the body in cooler shadow with subsurface-scattered orange glow on the shell. Three god-ray sunbeams cutting through the dark water from upper-left. Backlit silhouette read clear and powerful from any distance.

SCENE: deep underwater Pacific Ocean, dark teal-navy water gradient hex 001A3D top to 003A7D bottom. Bioluminescent particles drift through dark negative space. Far in lower background, blurred silhouettes of mangrove roots reach down. NO surface waves. NO sun in frame.

CHARACTER ANATOMY — Penaeus vannamei anthropomorphized with cinematic Pixar 3D craftsmanship:
- Single vibrant Naranja Vannamei body, hex F39A2B, with six clean abdominal segments curving into a fan tail (telson + uropods) at bottom. Subtle subsurface scattering, soft specular shell highlights, light translucency at segment joints. NO human legs. NO boots. The lower body IS the curved shrimp tail. Final, non-negotiable.
- Muscular humanoid torso fused into the cephalothorax, defined six-pack abs visible through the orange shell.
- Two muscular humanoid arms with bare orange skin, NO gloves, four fingers each (Pixar mascot convention).
- HEAD CLEAN AND ROUNDED: smooth shrimp head silhouette. Short soft rostrum tip max one eighth of head length. NO long beak, NO sword nose, NO forehead horn, NO serrated spikes, NO carapace teeth.
- EYES: medium expressive Pixar cartoon eyes, white sclera, rich dark pupil, single soft highlight. Set on very short eyestalks tucked close to head. Confident calm regal gaze. Eyebrows subtly raised in determination, NOT smiling, NOT bug-eyed.
- MOUTH: closed mouth or barely-parted lips with a quiet proud half-smile. Lips relaxed. NEVER toothy grin, NEVER open shouting mouth.
- ANTENNAE: TWO long thin elegant flexible antennae rising and curving softly outward like ribbon calligraphy. Both antennae fully visible, both ending in identical TRI-COLOR ECUADOR FLAG TASSELS — small rectangular flag-shaped fabric pieces with three CRISP HORIZONTAL STRIPES in this exact order from top to bottom: 1) YELLOW hex FFDD00 on top (thicker, double-width stripe like the real Ecuadorian flag), 2) BLUE hex 0033A0 in middle, 3) RED hex CE1126 at bottom. Both tassels visible, both fully tri-colored, both crisp and rectangular like miniature flags, NOT fluffy mechones, NOT brushes.

COSTUME — official Ecuanutrition ceremonial mantle wardrobe:
- CAPE: royal blue ceremonial mantle hex 0046AD, billowing in a long S-curve behind the body. The cape is attached at both shoulders by TWO IDENTICAL CIRCULAR CAPE CLASPS (broches) — gold rim hex F2C744 around a deep navy blue center hex 1E4670, with the official ECUANUTRITION emblem rendered inside each clasp: a tall elegant serif letter E in deep navy hex 1E4670 embraced by two flowing curved lines (one darker navy, one lighter cyan hex 7AAFD3) that form a circular shrimp silhouette around the E, with a small filled cyan dot above and to the right of the E. The two clasps must be visible on both shoulders, identical, glowing softly. NEVER a chest medallion, the Ecuanutrition emblem appears ONLY on the two shoulder clasps and on the belt medallion.
- BELT: sleek electric blue belt hex 1E88E5 around the waist. The word ECUAMAN in clean bold white sans-serif capital letters across the front of the belt.
- BELT MEDALLION: EXACTLY ONE circular medallion centered on the belt, larger than the shoulder clasps. Gold rim hex F2C744 around a white center, with the same official ECUANUTRITION emblem rendered at high detail inside: tall elegant serif letter E in deep navy hex 1E4670 embraced by two flowing curved lines (darker navy + lighter cyan hex 7AAFD3) forming a circular shrimp shape around the E, with a small filled cyan dot above and to the right. The medallion glows faintly cyan from inside like a soft arc-reactor pulse. This is the ONLY belt medallion in the entire image.
- TRIDENT: tall slender ceremonial weapon held diagonally across the body. Three sharp prongs at the top, the energy core glowing CYAN AQUA hex 00D9FF, soft plasma halo. The cyan glow of the trident matches the cyan glow of the medallion and shoulder clasps — visual continuity across the costume.

PALETTE OFFICIAL HEX (must be exact): F39A2B body, 0046AD cape, 1E88E5 belt, F2C744 gold medallion rim and clasp rims, 1E4670 deep navy in Ecuanutrition E and clasp center, 7AAFD3 light cyan in Ecuanutrition curves, 001A3D water top, 003A7D water bottom, 00D9FF trident plasma and inner medallion glow, FFDD00 antenna yellow, 0033A0 antenna blue, CE1126 antenna red, FFFFFF wordmark white.

STYLE: clean modern DreamWorks/Pixar 3D semi-realistic cinematic key art with the gravitas of an AQUAMAN movie poster, the bold color confidence of SPIDER-VERSE, and the warm character craft of COCO. Smooth subsurface-scattered shell, beautifully rendered cape fabric with weight and motion, extremely high detail, vibrant high-saturation colors, sharp focus on the character, dramatic warm-cool cinematic lighting, brand-new original design. Subject reads as a single iconic silhouette even at thumbnail scale.

REJECT in the output (do not generate any of these): generic AI mascot, long pointy beak, sword nose, forehead spike, forehead horn, multiple medallions on chest, rostrum teeth, serrated head, bug eyes, oversized eyes, toothy grin, open shouting mouth, gloves, boots, human legs, missing antennae, only one antenna with tassel, bicolor tassel, monocolor tassel, fluffy brush tassel, missing Ecuanutrition emblem on shoulders, missing Ecuanutrition emblem on belt medallion, watermarks, signatures, extra fingers, extra arms, two tridents, weapon halo on chest, aggressive grimace, military camo, blood, photorealistic human face, default Pixar baby face.
